status: Accepted for publication of the exact ordinary DEV startup optimization; Simulator and physical iPhone repair remain unverified
scope: Bounded startup optimization and publication of the identical reviewed candidate; no broad art or animation certification.
findings: All six original Mac WebKit captures inspected. Fresh New Game reaches Surface; Escape shows Surface Expedition paused; reload restores the saved-run menu; the replacement confirmation is visible; confirming it reaches Surface again. The report records exactly the expected two document navigations, no runtime exception and no crash.

All twenty original Chromium captures inspected. Worn is present in Mossvein, The Deep, Surface, Rootwound and Hub, including the four directional mining snapshots, walk exit and red outfit reentry. Iron and drill use their retained visuals. No new missing material, broken silhouette, shifted attachment or lost actor is visible.

Compared the previous Surface startup capture and previous Mossvein down, Worn outfit reentry and Rootwound originals. The reviewed candidate retains the approved appearance; pose timing can differ between captures. Existing edge framing in the Mossvein down and Rootwound views is also present in the baseline.

The Deepheart command capture visibly shows the restored Hub destination, not a separate Deepheart cavern. Touch release and resumed input are supported by report state; resumed position changes from [600,650] to [600,689.666809082031], then remains released.

Build, Chromium and WebKit reports bind the same source commit and all nine identical file identities. Exported input, overhaul 1259, touch 125 and DEV build-flavor cases passed; DEV save remains user://ever_deeper_dev_run_v3.sav.

Preparation succeeded under Godot 4.7.2 with flags 0. Source and reloaded prepared fingerprints are equal for 1033415 vertices, all surface arrays, bone rest/binds, transforms and paths. Source GLTF is 93042536 bytes (SHA256 a39203a578a0437e9c4781d90680fdc16994324908149729a156ff67022c82fb); compressed scene is 21837439 bytes (SHA256 f47b121fa7cae1b7ffcb8841e6b24e3c7e43e714a6cddb28499accefbf757d3c). Only always-overridden embedded mesh materials were removed.

Since round 1, build.py creates an isolated preparation project with gl_compatibility before invoking the same preparation script. Runtime rig, preparation script, native visual adapter and export preset hashes are unchanged from that review. The prepared scene loaded successfully in the actual candidate captures and active-rig report states.

No concrete blocker found in the final publisher source/workflow. The revised source preserves all inspected Mac visual/gameplay, preparation equality, exact-package provenance, LIVE/trial preservation, rollback and public-byte verification gates. It requires the Simulator attempt and assessment hashes, explicitly false Simulator/physical verification flags and the inconclusive assessment. The obsolete extra demand for successful Simulator automation was removed without marking that attempt passed or changing repository graphical/gameplay requirements.

Latest Simulator run 35608051678 requested one document and reached a native Safari session. Its original early.png, sample-01.png and sample-03.png were inspected and show Safari Start Page. Report has zero heartbeats, zero game taps and zero completed game captures; logs record a generic Close click followed by the 60-second session timeout. This is inconclusive automation evidence, not a passing or failing game startup result.

memory_observation.scope: Matched Mac WebKit sample endpoints only; process RSS values are not physical-device measurements or all-process peak memory.
memory_observation.interpretation: The approximately 33 percent reduction applies to sampled WebContent RSS after first startup. The paired GPU RSS increased; no equivalent total-browser reduction or original crash cause is established.

limits: Native Safari Simulator gameplay remains unverified. The first three attempts failed before any document; the latest requested one document but provided no heartbeat or game input and the inspected sampled frames show Safari Start Page. No candidate game outcome is inferred.
User video establishes physical Safari repeated-problem failure, but no OS jetsam log identifies its cause. The original Mac baseline also reached gameplay.
Neither Mac WebKit nor Simulator proves repaired behavior, memory headroom, heat or FPS on the user's physical iPhone.
Still captures and bounded interaction checks do not certify continuous-motion quality, all visual states, a numerical animation score or full 1.0 acceptance.
Protected invariant check remains failed for project.godot, hero_gear.gd, player_controller.gd and player_visual.gd; no clean invariant pass is claimed.

Acceptance is limited to publishing this tested DEV optimization with the physical-Safari limitation stated explicitly. It does not establish that the user's physical-device crash is repaired, waive repository visual/gameplay rules, or approve an uninspected publisher revision.
review_actions: Source and existing artifact inspection only. No game source mutation, rebuild, new test run or publication.
acceptance_basis: The repository graphical gate calls for final-candidate capture at the target mobile viewport, comparison with the approved appearance and gameplay checks. The exact candidate has these: twenty Chromium originals at 844x390 CSS/DPR2, six normal WebKit originals at 844x390 CSS/DPR3, checked approved asset derivation and passing gameplay. No independent repository requirement for a successful Simulator session was found. The added Simulator attempt remains an optional evidence gap, not a passed test or game failure.
